sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च सह चारणैः ।समेयुः च महात्मनो युद्ध दर्शन कांक्षया ॥३-२४-१९॥
transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca saha cāraṇaiḥ ।sameyuḥ ca mahātmano yuddha darśana kāṁkṣayā ॥3-24-19॥

translations.english: Then the gods along with gandharvas, siddhas, and celestial bards assembled there, wishing to witness the war.
